card.name: Linking word after drug, before non-drug item
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, or, including) right after a drug or medication term, where a non-drug item such as equipment, hospitalization or non-pharmacologic treatment comes next.

modes.label: Drugs and equipment
modes.description: The link word follows medication or drugs and leads into equipment in a resuscitation-readiness phrase.
modes.example: in a setting where cardiopulmonary resuscitation medication<< and>> equipment are available

modes.label: Medications and non-drug treatments
modes.description: The link word follows medications or non-pharmacological interventions and leads into non-drug options.
modes.example: consider alternative medications<< and>> non-pharmacologic treatments to address anxiety

card.writes: It pushes the model toward non-drug nouns like hardware, equipment or strategy and away from drug and software words.
card.plain: It marks the spot after a drug is named where the text turns to something that is not a drug, like equipment or non-drug care.
